DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その野菜をお持ち帰りですか。袋は必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you taking those vegetables home? Would you like a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この後も観光します。根に土が付いていますが、ここで払ってから袋に入れてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 観光中の持運びと売場で土を落とす可否を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sightseeing afterward too. There is soil on the roots; may I brush it off here before putting them in a bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss carrying them while sightseeing and whether soil may be removed in the sales area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 売場で土を落とすのはお控えください。そのまま包んでお持ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please refrain from removing soil in the sales area. You can carry them wrapped as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、包んでください。ほかの土産と同じ袋に入れず、分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 土付きで包装し他の土産と別袋に頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then please wrap them. I'd like them separated rather than put in the same bag as my other souvenirs.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the soil-covered vegetables to be wrapped in a separate bag from other souvenirs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別にしますね。持ち歩く間、つぶれないように気を付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll separate them. Please take care not to crush them while carrying them.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夕方まで荷物と一緒に持ち歩きます。実はこの葉の部分も食べるのか、よく分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持歩予定と食用部位の疑問を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll carry them with my luggage until evening. Actually, I don't really know whether this leafy part is eaten too.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your carrying plans and ask about the edible parts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 生産者の説明がこちらにあります。食べる部分と、下処理について書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the grower's explanation. It describes the parts to eat and preparation.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真に残していいですか。料理名だけでは分からないので、洗うところから説明を読みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 生産者の下処理説明を写真で残す許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: May I photograph it? I can't tell from the dish name alone, so I'd like to read the explanation starting from washing.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask permission to photograph the grower's preparation instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。細かな調理方法は、その案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. Please check that guidance for detailed cooking methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を撮りました。土付きのまま別に包んで、帰宅してから表示を見ながら下処理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別包装と帰宅後の下処理を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've photographed it. I'll have them wrapped separately with the soil still on, then prepare them at home while checking the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide on separate wrapping and preparation after returning home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが分けた袋です。持ち歩く際は重い荷物の下に入れないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the separate bag. Please don't put it under heavy luggage while carrying it.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 上りの乗車券を確認します。お帰りもご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll check your ticket for the ascent. Will you be using it for the return too?

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 往復です。この時刻が書いてあるので、帰りも同じ時間に予約されているのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往復券記載時刻が帰り指定か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a round trip. Since this time is written on it, does that mean the return is also reserved for the same time?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the time on the round-trip ticket specifies the return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは上りの乗車の案内です。帰りの乗車時刻を指定したものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is information for boarding uphill. It doesn't specify your return boarding time.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 帰りは別に考えるんですね。下りの最終便は、どの掲示を見れば分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 上り時刻と理解し当日最終便掲示を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I need to consider the return separately. Which notice shows the last downhill departure?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that it is the ascent time and ask for the day's final-departure notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本日の運行案内はこちらです。運行状況が変わる場合もありますので、山頂でもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today's operating information is here. Conditions can change, so please check at the summit too.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この下の時刻ですね。麓で待つ友人と待合せがあるので、最終便より早く下りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 掲示を確認し麓の待合せで早めに下りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's this lower time, then. I'm meeting a friend waiting at the foot, so I'd like to go down before the last departure.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the notice and say that you want to descend early for a meeting at the foot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 下りの乗り場で待ち時間が出る場合もあります。滞在時間に余裕を持ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: There may be a wait at the downhill boarding point too. Allow extra time for your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 展望台と散歩の両方を考えていましたが、今日は展望台だけにします。券は帰りまで持っていていいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待時間に備え散歩を省き券保持を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was considering both the observation deck and a walk, but today I'll do only the deck. I should keep the ticket until the return, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Omit the walk to allow for waiting time and confirm keeping the ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。往復の券をなくさないようお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please keep your round-trip ticket safe.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 山頂で運行案内を確認して、散歩はせず早めに乗り場へ戻ります。友人にも予定を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 山頂でも状況確認して早めに下りへ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check operating information at the summit and return to the boarding point early without taking a walk. I'll tell my friend the plan too.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check conditions at the summit too and head down early. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、上りはこちらへお進みください。お帰りの券も手元に残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed this way for the ascent. Keep the return ticket with you too.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次はこちらの区画をお願いします。目印は見えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please work on this section next. Can you see the marker?

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 赤いひもが見えます。ひもの向こう側まで植えると思っていましたが、合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 目印の向こうまで担当か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I see a red string. I thought I should plant beyond it too; is that right?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether your assignment extends beyond the marker. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 向こうは別の人の担当です。こちら側で、植えていない所を進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The far side is someone else's assignment. Work on the unplanted spots on this side.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ひもは進む方向ではなく、区画の境目なんですね。足元の苗を踏まないよう、どこから入ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 境界を理解し苗を踏まない入口を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the string marks the section boundary, not the direction to move. Where should I enter so I don't step on the seedlings near my feet?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the boundary and ask for an entrance that avoids stepping on seedlings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この空いている所から入ります。植えた列を横切らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Enter through this empty space. Don't cut across the planted rows.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここからですね。歩いていて苗が倒れたら、その場で直していいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定入口を復唱し倒れた苗の対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Through here, correct? If a seedling falls over while I'm walking, may I fix it on the spot?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Repeat the designated entrance and ask what to do about a fallen seedling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず知らせてください。倒れた原因と場所を見て、直し方を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell us first. We'll look at the cause and location and explain how to fix it.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の判断で植え直さず、場所を指して呼びます。ぬかるみで動きにくい時も、無理に進まないほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自己判断の植直しを避けぬかるみ時の停止を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't replant it on my own judgment; I'll point out the location and call you. If the mud makes moving difficult, I shouldn't force my way forward either, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid replanting on your own and confirm stopping when movement in mud is difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。転びそうなら作業を止めて声を掛けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If you might fall, stop work and call out.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当はこちら側だけ、入口はこの空いた所ですね。苗と足元を確認しながら始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当範囲と入口を確定して開始する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: My assignment is only this side, and the entrance is this empty space, correct? I'll start while watching the seedlings and my footing.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your assigned area and entrance before starting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その範囲でお願いします。分からなくなったら、植える前に呼んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please stay within that area. If you're unsure, call me before planting.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めてお越しですか。お風呂の用品はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this your first visit? Do you have your bathing supplies?

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: タオルはありますが、シャンプーを忘れました。浴室にある物を使えばいいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 用品忘れと浴室共用の思込みを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a towel, but I forgot shampoo. I thought I could use whatever was in the bathing area.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you forgot supplies and assumed the items in the bathing area were shared. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 他のお客様が置いている私物もありますので、置いてあるだけで共用品とは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Some items there are other guests' personal belongings, so being left there doesn't necessarily make them shared supplies.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前のないボトルでも勝手に使わないほうがいいですね。受付で買える物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無記名私物も使わず受付購入を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I shouldn't use even an unnamed bottle without permission. Is there anything I can buy at reception?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will not use unnamed personal items either, and ask about buying at reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この使い切りの商品をご覧いただけます。シャンプーとボディーソープは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can look at these single-use products. Shampoo and body wash are separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 体を洗う物も必要です。この二つを一つずつお願いします。タオルは自分の物を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要な二種類と自前タオルを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I need something to wash my body too. One of each of these two, please. I'll use my own towel.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the two necessary product types and your own towel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承りました。初めての方には、脱衣所と浴室の使い方もご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. For first-time guests, we'll also explain how to use the changing and bathing areas.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。ぬれたタオルを置く場所が分からない時は、浴室の中でも聞いていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使い方案内を求め浴室内の質問可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. If I'm unsure where to put a wet towel, may I ask inside the bathing area too?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request usage guidance and ask whether questions can be asked in the bathing area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からないことがあれば職員にお声掛けください。浴槽へはタオルを入れないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please speak to staff if anything is unclear. Please don't put towels in the bath.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの用品と自分のタオルを持って入ります。私物のボトルには触らず、困ったら職員に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用品とタオルを持ち私物に触らない利用を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll go in with the two supplies and my own towel. I won't touch personal bottles, and I'll ask staff if I have trouble.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm using the supplies and towel without touching personal belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが商品です。脱衣所への入口をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the products. I'll show you the entrance to the changing area.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の皆様がそろいましたね。こちらのお席へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Everyone on your reservation has arrived, correct? Please come to these seats.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の集まりですが、少し仕事の話もします。周りに聞こえにくい席はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 業務話がある会社集まりで聞こえにくい席を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a company gathering, but we'll discuss work a little too. Is there a table where people around us are less likely to hear?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a less audible table for a company gathering involving work discussion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 離れた席はありますが、個室ではありません。周りに聞こえないとお約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are more distant tables, but no private room. We can't promise others won't hear.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら、顧客の名前が出る打合せは店ではしないことにします。食事だけの席としてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 機密の保証なしを受け顧客名の打合せを店外へ延期する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then we won't have a meeting involving customer names in the restaurant. Please treat it as a meal only.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Accept the lack of a confidentiality guarantee and postpone the customer-name meeting until outside the restaurant. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。お食事の開始は、このままでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Shall we start the meal as planned?

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。ただ、資料の封筒を机に置かず、かばんへ戻してから注文します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食事開始を維持し資料をかばんへ戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. But I'll put the document envelope back in my bag instead of leaving it on the table before ordering.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the meal start as planned and put the documents back in your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。お料理は予約された内容で準備しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. We're preparing the food you reserved.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予約の料理はそのままでお願いします。遅れて来る同僚には、打合せを別の日にすると連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料理維持と遅着同僚へ打合せ延期を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please keep the reserved food as it is. I'll tell the colleague arriving late that we'll hold the meeting another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the food reservation and tell the late-arriving colleague that the meeting is postponed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お席の人数は変わりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will the number of people at the table remain the same?

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 人数は同じです。ここでは食事をして、仕事の資料は開きません。遅れる同僚の席も残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人数を維持し資料非展開で遅着席も残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: The number is the same. We'll eat here and won't open the work documents. Please keep a seat for the late colleague too.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Maintain the headcount, leave documents unopened, and keep the late-arrival seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 同じ人数のお食事で承りました。皆様の飲み物がお決まりになりましたら伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-OTAGUNMA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Confirmed as a meal for the same number of people. I'll take your drinks order when everyone has decided.

DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご入浴の受付ですね。初めてのご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're checking in to use the baths, correct? Is it your first time?

DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めてです。義足を使っています。脱衣所から浴室まで、外して移動するのは難しいです。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 義足を外しての移動が難しいと受付へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's my first time. I use a prosthetic leg. It's difficult for me to move from the changing area to the baths with it removed.
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell reception that moving without your prosthetic leg is difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 移動方法を担当者と確認します。義足をぬらしてよいかは、ご自身で確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check mobility arrangements with the person in charge. Have you personally confirmed whether your prosthetic leg may get wet?

DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 水に対応していないので、浴槽には入れられません。脱衣所までは着けて歩きたいです。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 水非対応と脱衣所までの希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-04.translation: It isn't water-compatible, so I can't put it in the bath. I'd like to walk wearing it as far as the changing area.
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is not water-compatible and you want to wear it to the changing area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。段差や座れる場所をご説明してから、利用方法を相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Let's explain steps and places to sit first, then discuss how you might use the facilities.

DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。説明を聞いて難しそうなら、今日は入浴せず休憩だけにしても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明後入浴を見送る選択を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. If it sounds difficult after the explanation, would it be all right to skip bathing today and only use the rest area?
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the option to forgo bathing after hearing the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その場合の受付内容も確認します。お一人でお越しですか。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the reception arrangements in that case too. Did you come alone?

DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族と来ましたが、持ち上げてもらって移動するのは避けたいです。自分で移動できる範囲を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族の抱え上げを避け自立移動の範囲を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I came with family, but I'd like to avoid having them lift and carry me. I'd like to know how far I can move independently.
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the extent of independent mobility while avoiding family lifting you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず設備を担当者から説明します。無理な介助を前提にせず検討しましょう。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. The person in charge will explain the facilities first. Let's consider it without presuming strenuous assistance.

DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いてから入浴するか決めます。今は入浴の受付を進めず、担当の方と相談させてください。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付前に設備説明で利用可否を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll decide whether to bathe after hearing the explanation. Please don't proceed with bathing admission yet; let me discuss it with the person in charge.
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide on use after a facility explanation before admission is processed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらでお待ちください。移動と受付の両方を確認できる担当者を呼びます。
DLG-SC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here. I'll call someone who can check both mobility and reception arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お部屋は和室です。夕食の間に布団を敷く予定ですが、よろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Your room is Japanese style. We plan to lay out the futons during dinner; is that all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 子どもが早く寝るので、夕食より前に布団を用意してもらえるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 子の早寝に合わせ夕食前の布団準備を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: My child goes to bed early, so I'd like to ask whether the futons could be prepared before dinner.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request futon preparation before dinner to suit your child's early bedtime. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 準備の担当へ確認します。お子さんは、もうお休みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll check with the preparation staff. Is your child already asleep?

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まだ起きています。先に寝かせてから職員の方に入ってもらうと、起こしてしまいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 未就寝と後入室による起床懸念を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Still awake. If we put them to bed first and have staff come in afterward, it might wake them.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that the child is not yet asleep and later entry might wake them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今でしたら先に準備できると返事が来ました。準備中は荷物をまとめていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I've heard back that they can prepare them first if it's now. Could you gather your luggage during preparation?

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。部屋に着いたら床に荷物を広げず、机の脇へまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 早期対応を受け床を空けて荷物をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. When we reach the room, I won't spread luggage over the floor; I'll gather it beside the table.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Accept the earlier preparation and gather luggage to clear the floor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。布団はご予約の人数分でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. Should the futons be for the number of people on your reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。子どもの分も含めた予約のままです。寝る場所を勝手に変えず、準備の後で使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 予約人数維持で準備後に寝る段取りを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. The reservation including my child is unchanged. I won't change sleeping places on my own; we'll use them after preparation.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Maintain the reserved headcount and confirm using the sleeping arrangements after preparation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。夕食中の布団準備は、今の準備へ変更します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. We'll change the dinner-time futon setup to preparing them now.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 先に布団をお願いし、荷物を脇へまとめます。子どもが寝た後には、予定外の準備が残らないかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 早期布団と就寝後の残作業有無を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll request the futons first and gather luggage to the side. I'd also like to check whether any unplanned setup will remain after my child is asleep.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm the early futons and whether work remains after bedtime. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 担当へ伝えました。部屋の準備が済んだ際に、残っている案内も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've told the person in charge. When the room preparation is finished, please also check any remaining guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そちらは試食用です。よろしければ、お一つどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: That's a sample for tasting. Please try one if you like.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 買う商品だと思ってかごに入れようとしていました。販売用はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 試食と誤認した商品を訂正して販売品を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I thought it was a product to buy and was about to put it in my basket. Where are the ones for sale?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Correct your confusion about the sample and ask for sale products. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 販売用はこちらの箱です。試食は売場でお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: These boxes are for sale. Please eat samples in the sales area.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 試食はここでいただきます。友人に渡すのは明後日ですが、箱の期限を見てもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 試食の場所を守り渡す日の期限を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll eat the sample here. I'm giving the product to my friend the day after tomorrow; may I check the date on the box?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Respect the sample location and check the date for the day you will give it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: どうぞ。期限は箱ごとに表示されています。お持ち歩きの時間もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Of course. The date is printed on each box. Please also check how long you'll carry it.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今日は電車で四時間ほど持ち歩きます。保存方法に冷蔵とある物は避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 持歩時間と冷蔵を避ける条件を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll carry it by train for about four hours today. I'd like to avoid anything whose storage directions say refrigerated.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain the carrying time and your condition of avoiding refrigerated products. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの商品は常温の表示です。ただし、暑い場所や直射日光を避けるよう書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: This product says room temperature. However, it also says to avoid hot places and direct sunlight.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この表示なら、車内では手元に置いて持ち帰ります。小分けにして渡せるよう、一つずつ包装されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 表示に沿う持運びと個包装を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: With these directions, I'll keep it beside me on the train and take it home. Is it individually wrapped so I can give out portions?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm carrying it according to the directions and ask about individual wrapping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの箱は個包装です。箱の保存表示と期限も、渡す方にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: This box contains individually wrapped pieces. Please also tell the people receiving them the box's storage directions and date.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ではこの箱にします。箱を捨てる前に表示を写真に残して、友人にも知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 購入品を決め表示を渡す相手にも共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Then I'll choose this box. Before throwing it away, I'll photograph the label and let my friend know too.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Choose the product and share the label information with the recipient too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: こちらをお包みします。試食の紙は、そちらの専用の箱へお捨てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll wrap this one. Please discard the sample paper in that dedicated container.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お待ちのバスは、どちらへ向かう便ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Which direction is the bus you're waiting for going?

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 東京へ行きます。停留所の名前が予約と同じなので、ここで待っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 同名停留所で待つ東京行き予約を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'm going to Tokyo. The stop name is the same as my reservation, so I'm waiting here.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you have a Tokyo-bound reservation and are waiting at a stop with the same name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 名前は同じですが、こちらは反対方向の乗り場です。予約の行先を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: The name is the same, but this boarding point is for the opposite direction. Could you show me your reserved destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらです。行先まで見ていませんでした。向こうへ行くのに、この道路を横断してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 方向違いを理解し横断の可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here it is. I hadn't checked the destination. May I cross this road to get to the other side?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the direction mismatch and ask whether crossing is allowed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ここでは渡らず、横断できる場所へ回ってください。道順をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Don't cross here; go around to a place where you can cross. I'll explain the route.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 大きな荷物があります。階段がある経路でしょうか。少し遠くても階段を避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 荷物を理由に階段のない経路を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have large luggage. Does the route have stairs? I'd like to avoid stairs even if it's a bit farther.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request a route without stairs because of your luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この歩道から横断歩道へ進む経路なら、階段は使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: The route along this sidewalk to the pedestrian crossing doesn't use stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その経路で行きます。移動中に便が来そうですが、ここから乗せてもらうことはできませんよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 正規経路を選び誤乗場から乗れないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll take that route. The bus may arrive while I'm moving, but I can't board it from here, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Choose the proper route and confirm you cannot board from the wrong stop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 別方向の停留所からその便に乗ることはできません。乗り場へ着いて、便の表示を再確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: You can't board that bus from the stop for the other direction. Once you reach the boarding point, check the bus display again.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 正しい乗り場へ歩道から向かいます。間に合わなかった場合は、予約の連絡先で次の扱いを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 正しい行先確認と遅れた場合の照会を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll head to the correct boarding point along the sidewalk. If I miss it, I'll ask the reservation contact what happens next.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Decide to check the correct destination and ask if you are late. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 行先は東京方面です。荷物を持って、横断歩道のあるほうへお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: The direction is toward Tokyo. Take your luggage and proceed toward the pedestrian crossing.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まず道具をお見せします。まだ手に取らず、ご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: First I'll show you the utensils. Please look without picking them up yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この細い棒でお茶を混ぜるんですか。名前も一緒に覚えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 用途を推測して道具名を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Do you stir tea with this thin stick? I'd like to learn the name too.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Guess the use and ask for the utensil's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それは茶杓です。抹茶をすくう道具です。混ぜる時には、こちらの茶筅を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: That is a chashaku, a scoop for matcha. For mixing, we use this chasen whisk.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: すくう物と混ぜる物が別なんですね。茶杓を置く場所も見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 茶杓の用途を理解し置き場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: So scooping and mixing use different tools. Could you also show me where to put the chashaku?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the chashaku's use and ask where to place it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この位置に戻します。次に茶碗に抹茶を入れるところを実演します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Return it to this position. Next I'll demonstrate putting matcha into the bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一度見てから真似したいです。途中で止めて、手の向きを確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 実演後模倣し途中確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to watch once before copying. May I stop partway through to check my hand's orientation?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to imitate after the demonstration and check midway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: もちろんです。作法の説明は一度に覚えなくて大丈夫ですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Of course. You don't have to memorize all the etiquette at once.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今の動きをやってみます。茶杓はこの向きで持っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 実際の持ち方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. I'll try that movement now. Am I holding the chashaku in this direction?
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check how you are actually holding it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。その向きです。少量をすくって茶碗へ入れたら、茶杓を元の位置に戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, that's the direction. Scoop a small amount into the bowl, then return the chashaku to its original position.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 入れられました。茶杓も戻しました。今日は持ち方と、すくうところまで練習できました。茶筅は次の体験で教わりたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 抹茶を入れて茶杓を戻し今回の練習を終えて次回の希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've put it in and returned the chashaku. Today I practiced holding and scooping. I'd like to learn the chasen at my next session.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say that you have added matcha and returned the chashaku, finish today's practice, and state your wish for next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 茶杓の練習はこれで終わりです。道具も元の位置に戻せましたね。次の体験でも、一つずつ進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-SHIBUKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: That ends the chashaku practice. You've returned the tool to its place too. Let's proceed one step at a time at your next session as well.
